title: The Last Buna
style_block: A realistic documentary photograph on 35mm film: soft natural light, shallow depth of field, fine film grain, a muted earthy palette of charcoal black, warm brown, cream white and deep green, with one accent colour, the blue of a painted door.
world_block: Any person is Ethiopian, with dark brown skin, and is seen only from behind, from far away, or as hands and forearms; no face is ever visible. Any woman is in her sixties, wearing a long white handwoven cotton dress with a thin coloured woven border and a white cotton shawl covering her hair and shoulders. Any young man wears a plain dark jacket and trousers, with short black hair. Any coffee pot is a jebena: a black unglazed clay pot with a round ball-shaped body, a tall narrow neck, a straw stopper, one curved handle and a small side spout; never a metal kettle or a glass pot. Any coffee cup is a sini: a very small white porcelain cup without a handle, standing on a low rectangular wooden tray table. Any room is a modest Ethiopian home with smooth mud-plastered walls, an earth floor scattered with long fresh green grass, and a small round clay charcoal stove; no modern kitchen, no electric appliances. Any house is small, with a rusted corrugated tin roof and a wooden door painted blue. Any outdoor view is the green hills of south-west Ethiopia in the rainy season: red earth, coffee trees with glossy dark leaves and red cherries, and broad false banana plants under a grey sky.

reference_sheet.prompt: Inside a modest Ethiopian home in morning light: a black clay jebena coffee pot with a round body and tall narrow neck beside a low wooden tray of very small white handleless cups, long fresh green grass scattered on the earth floor, a small clay charcoal stove glowing, a thin line of incense smoke, a blue painted wooden door in the mud-plastered wall behind, and an older woman in a white cotton dress and white shawl seen from behind.

music.caption: A gentle, nostalgic instrumental score featuring a warm acoustic krar, soft ambient pads, and subtle percussive pulses. Gentle texture with no strong lead melody, evoking a cozy home in 2020s modern Ethiopia.

cues.note: Warm ambient pads introduce a quiet, reflective morning mood
Acoustic krar plucks enter gently as coffee is roasted
Melody softens to a gentle sigh during the emotional parting
Opening krar theme returns as the traveler comes back home
Music fades softly into a lingering, warm chord

end_card.text: This film was made with AI.

shots.image_prompt: Before sunrise, a small house with a rusted corrugated tin roof and a blue painted wooden door stands in the centre, on red earth among coffee trees and false banana plants. Thin smoke rises from the roof. Green misty hills behind, grey-blue dawn sky. Nobody is in the picture.
shots.motion_prompt: slow push in. Thin smoke drifts up from the tin roof, leaves sway slightly, mist moves over the hills. Nobody appears.

shots.subtitle_en: Emaye Zewditu lives in a small tin roofed house in Jimma.
shots.reason: Establishes the lonely setting to ground the audience in a feeling of quiet solitude.

shots.image_prompt: Extreme close-up from directly above of an earth floor being covered with long fresh green grass. Only two dark brown hands and the cuffs of white cotton sleeves enter from the top edge, scattering the grass. No head, no body and no face are in the picture. Dim warm light.

The pan is full of coffee beans, half still pale green and half roasted dark brown and shiny. Thin white smoke rises. A woman's dark brown hand holds the pan's long handle at the edge of the picture.
shots.motion_prompt: slow push in. The hand shakes the pan gently, beans roll and darken, smoke rises, embers glow and flicker.

narration.am: በብረት ምጣድ ላይ ጥሬ ቡና ታቆላለች።

Steam rises from the cup. No head, no body and no face are in the picture.

narration.am: ሦስተኛውና የመጨረሻው ሲኒ በረካ ይባላል፤ ትርጉሙም በረከት ነው።

shots.subtitle_en: The third and last cup is called baraka, which means blessing.
shots.reason: Highlights the poignant detail of the double setup that evokes longing.

shots.image_prompt: Seen from behind and far away, an old white and blue country bus drives away down a red earth road that winds through green coffee hills toward the horizon, dust rising behind it. shots.image_prompt: From inside a dim room, an older woman in a long white cotton dress and white shawl is seen from behind, standing in the centre in an open blue doorway and looking out at a red earth road and misty green hills. Her face is not visible.

narration.am: ያ ሦስተኛው ሲኒ ሁልጊዜ የእሱ እንደሆነ ነገረችው።

shots.image_prompt: Extreme close-up of a low wooden tray on an earth floor covered with green grass, indoors. Exactly two very small white handleless porcelain cups stand on the tray, both empty. narration.am: በየማለዳው በረከቦቱ ላይ ሁለት አነስተኛ ነጭ ሲኒዎችን ታዘጋጃለች።

shots.motion_prompt: slow push in. Nothing moves except dust in the fading window light. The stool stays empty; nobody enters.

narration.am: ሁለቱን ሲኒዎች ጠጥታ ሦስተኛውን ሲኒ እንዲጠብቅ ታስቀራለች።

narration.am: ዳዊት አቧራ የለበሰ ቦርሳ ይዞ ደረሰና ተቀመጠ።
